comment: Independent restore.c getlev() 1149-1163 witness: getlev() pushes each saved trap onto the front of gf.ftrap, so a level the hero returns to has its trap chain reversed. A debug Samurai enters the tutorial, level-teleports to tut-2 and back, and runs #wizwhere; dungeon.c print_dungeon() reports the first MAGIC_PORTAL on the chain, which tut-1.lua's six portals make visible: (7,7) after the return, while a freshly made level's chain starts with the last portal created, at (69,5). The second game, a dwarven Valkyrie on another seed and date, returns to tut-1 by climbing tut-2's up stairs instead, a different goto_level() arrival through the same getlev(). Seeds, dates, characters and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
